entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about an order I received a little while ago. I'd like to start a return for a helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number please?
Thank you. I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet here. Just to be sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's just a preference thing. My wife bought it for me, but the color doesn't quite match my bike. The box is still unopened, so the helmet has never been used.
I understand completely. Getting the right color is important. Let me just check the delivery date... I see it arrived 42 days ago. One moment.
Alright, I've checked our policy. Since it's within our 90-day return window for standard gear, you are absolutely eligible for a full refund. We can definitely process that for you.

That's great to hear. Now, I am planning to buy the same helmet in a different color from your site. Since I'll have to cover the return shipping, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

I understand why you're asking. Unfortunately, my system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for preference-based returns. However, the good news is you will receive a full refund for the item cost once we receive it back.
I see. Not even a 5% coupon? It would just make the whole exchange feel a bit smoother.

I do apologize, but I'm not authorized to offer credits on this type of return. My main goal is to ensure you get the right gear. After all, having a helmet you're happy with is a key part of rider safety. I can email you the return label and instructions right now to get the process started.
Okay, that's fair enough. A full refund is the most important part. Please go ahead and send that email.
Perfect. I've just sent that over to the email on file. You should see it in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
